column1: 21755§enterprise§ˈentəpraɪz§The land can be considered part of the enterprise's assets.§这块土地可以归入该**公司**的资产。§
21756§verify§ˈverɪfaɪ§In some California housing estates, a key alone is insufficient to get someone in the door; his or her voiceprint must also be verified.§在加州的一些住宅区，进入房间仅靠一把钥匙是不够的，还需要**确认**声波纹。§
21757§string§strɪŋ§When the motor runs, the string will wind up around the shaft.§当发动机开始运转，**细绳**就会绕着把柄卷起来。§
21758§litter§ˈlɪtə(r)§Cowpats would litter pastures, making grass inedible to cattle and depriving the soil of sunlight.§牛粪会**弄脏**牧草，使草变得不适合牛群食用，也使土壤得不到阳光的照射。§
21759§manor§ˈmænə(r)§Within the grounds are a Georgian mansion, an Elizabethan dairy and the tower of a medieval manor.§在这片地区，有一所乔治时期的住宅、一个伊丽莎白时期的牛奶场，以及一座中世纪**庄园**的塔楼。§
21760§location§ləʊˈkeɪʃn§Which picture shows the correct location of the administration office?§哪一幅图显示的是管理处的正确**位置**？§
21761§breakdown§ˈbreɪkdaʊn§Gloomy people are likely to suffer from a nervous breakdown.§忧郁的人容易精神**崩溃**。§

21762§irresistible§ˌɪrɪˈzɪstəbl§Later the lava cools slowly into a huge, hard, stable plug which blocks any further eruption until the pressure below becomes irresistible.§随后岩浆慢慢冷却，变成巨大、坚硬而稳固的岩颈，阻碍火山进一步喷发，直到喷发的压力变得**势不可挡**。§
21763§fluency§ˈfluːənsi§Fluency in French is required for this job.§这项工作要求能讲一口**流利**的法语。§
21764§transcription§trænˈskrɪpʃn§Transcriptions always benefit from any additional commentary provided by an observer.§**手抄本**总是能从阅评者的附加评注中得到完善。§
21765§introspection§ˌɪntrəˈspekʃn§These situations are best resolved with the minimum of introspection or self-analysis.§通过最低程度的**自我反省**或自我分析，圆满地解决了这些问题。§
21766§elicitation§ɪˌlɪsɪˈteɪʃn§There are also several direct methods of elicitation, such as asking information to fill in the blanks.§这里也有一些直接的**引导**办法，例如在空格处填上所问的信息。§改音标：书上印成 ˌɪˈlɪsɪˈteɪʃn，次重音位置错
21767§informant§ɪnˈfɔːmənt§The journalist refused to reveal the identity of his informant.§记者拒绝披露**消息提供者**的身份。§
21768§ambiguity§ˌæmbɪˈgjuːəti§There was an element of ambiguity in the actor's reply.§演员的回答有些**模棱两可**。§
21769§generative§ˈdʒenərətɪv§The convenience of this approach makes it widely used, and it is considered the norm in the generative approach to linguistics.§这种方法的便捷性使其被广泛应用，并且被视为语言学**生成**研究的规范。§

21770§recourse§rɪˈkɔːs§A linguist's personal judgements are often uncertain, or disagree with the judgements of other linguists, at which point recourse is needed to more objective methods of enquiry, using non-linguists as informant.§语言学家的个人判断通常是不可靠的，或者与其他语言学家的判断不一致，这时就需要**求助于**更加客观的调查方法，选择非语言学家作为语料供应人。§

21771§scrupulous§ˈskruːpjələs§For larger studies, scrupulous attention has been paid to the sampling theory employed, and in all cases, decisions have to be made about the best investigative techniques to use.§对于更大的课题研究，就需要**特别**注意抽样理论的应用，在所有情况下，要注意选择使用最佳的调查方法。§
21772§utterance§ˈʌtərəns§Linguists ask their informants for utterances that describe certain actions, objects or behaviours.§语言学家让他们的语料供应人用**话语**描述某些动作、物体或行为。§改译文：原译文没译出 utterances，加「用话语」

21773§emeritus§ɪˈmerɪtəs§Michael Yessis, an emeritus professor of Sports Science at California State University at Fullerton, maintains that genetics only determined about one third of what an athlete can do.§加州州立大学富勒顿分校体育科学系**名誉**教授迈克尔·耶西认为基因对一名运动员的能力来说只起1/3的作用。§
21774§bilingual§ˌbaɪˈlɪŋgwəl§She works as a bilingual assistant for an American boss.§她是一位美国老板的**双语**助理。§
21775§substitution§ˌsʌbstɪˈtjuːʃn§It seems that the director is going to make a substitution for the old program.§看起来导演准备**替换**掉老节目。§
21776§mundane§mʌnˈdeɪn§Susan busied herself with the mundane task of cleaning the house.§苏珊用打扫房间这样**平常**的工作让自己忙起来。§
21777§foreseeable§fɔːˈsiːəbl§For the foreseeable future, records will be made to be broken.§在**不久**的将来，记录将被打破。§
21778§hurl§hɜːl§Mr. Lee hurled the book across the room while he was in a fury.§李先生暴怒之下将书本从房间一头**扔**向另一头。§
21779§invoke§ɪnˈvəʊk§Police can invoke the law of human rights to regulate the perpetrators.§警察可以**通过**人权法来管理闹事者。§
21780§duplicate§ˈdjuːplɪkeɪt§These methods include strength training that duplicates what they are doing in their running events as well as plyometrics.§这些方法包含力量训练，这与他们在跑步中以及肌肉增强训练中所做的**完全一致**。§
21781§mushroom§ˈmʌʃrʊm§The profit of this company is expected to mushroom to $50 million by 2030.§这家公司的利润到2030年有望**猛增**到五千万美金。§
21782§adaptation§ˌædæpˈteɪʃn§The simplicity of Indian ways of life has been judged an evolutionary adaptation to forest ecology.§印第安人的生活方式很简单，这被认为是在进化中**适应**森林生态环境的结果。§
21783§elite§eɪˈliːt§This country's Internet elite have begun to emerge in recent years.§近年来，该国涌现出一批网络**精英**。§
21784§up-to-date§ˌʌp tə ˈdeɪt§The data gave lexicographers access to an up-to-date daily language.§这些资料为词典编纂者提供了**最新**的日常用语。§
21785§bury§ˈberi§Some birds bury their eggs under the ground.§有些鸟将自己的蛋**埋**在地下。§
21786§moderate§ˈmɒdərət§The people can bear moderate price increases in the market.§人们能够忍受市场上**适度**的涨价。§
21787§bold§bəʊld§The International Style was largely characterised by the bold use of new materials and simple, geometric forms.§“国际风格”的特征主要体现在**大胆**使用新材料和简单的几何形状上。§
21788§award§əˈwɔːd§Our experience would suggest that the long-term effects of incentive awards on absenteeism are questionable.§我们的经验表明，以激励**奖**来解决旷课问题的长期效果值得质疑。§
21789§hassle§ˈhæsl§Bob didn't want the hassle of commuting to work, so he took a job close to his home.§鲍勃不想每天很**麻烦**地乘车往返于家和公司之间，于是就在离家不远的地方找了份工作。§
21790§addict§ˈædɪkt§The most tragical sight of all is the very young addicts.§最悲惨的一幕是目睹那些非常年轻的**吸毒者**。§
21791§restrain§rɪˈstreɪn§The doctors restrained the patient from hurting himself.§医生**制止**了病人的自残行为。§
21792§reproduce§ˌriːprəˈdjuːs§Photographs, postcards and films enable memories to be endlessly reproduced.§照片、明信片和电影让往事在脑海中不断**重现**。§
21793§signpost§ˈsaɪnpəʊst§The Education Centre is signposted at every crossing in the college.§该大学的每个十字路口处都设有通往教育中心的**路标**。§
21794§intent§ɪnˈtent§He came with intent to defraud.§他怀着欺骗的**意图**而来。§
21795§artefact§ˈɑːtɪfækt§The museum collections included approximately 300,000 artefacts.§博物馆里收藏了大约30万件**手工艺品**。§
21796§application§ˌæplɪˈkeɪʃn§I think this invention has many useful applications.§我认为这项发明非常有用，会被广泛**应用**。§
21797§acquaintance§əˈkweɪntəns§It was in the United States that I made the acquaintance of Professor Jones.§我是在美国**结识**琼斯教授的。§改例句：acquaintance 被断行连字符拆成 acquain-tance
21798§challenge§ˈtʃælɪndʒ§The greatest challenge in this respect is time.§这一方面面临的最大**挑战**是时间问题。§
21799§guideline§ˈgaɪdlaɪn§These standards are based on guidelines set out by the major control boards.§这些标准是基于主管委员会拟定的**指导方针**制定的。§
21800§hemisphere§ˈhemɪsfɪə(r)§The left hemisphere of the brain controls the right half of the body.§左**脑**控制身体的右半部分。§改音标：书上印成 ˈhemɪˌsfɪə(r)，sf 中间多了次重音
21801§civil§ˈsɪvl§Personality questionnaires were used by the ancient Chinese for picking out civil servants.§古代中国人用性格问卷来挑选**政府文职**人员。§
21802§viable§ˈvaɪəbl§In order to develop an economically viable hotel organisation model, they decided to implement some new policies.§为了能够开发一种在经济上**切实可行**的酒店管理模式，他们决定采用一些新政策。§
21803§gigantic§dʒaɪˈgæntɪk§A gigantic explosion tore buildings around the bomb to fragments.§**巨大**的爆炸将炸弹周围的建筑物炸得粉碎。§
21804§venue§ˈvenjuː§This team will play here or at other venues all over the country.§这支队伍将会在这或者国内的其他**赛场**比赛。§
21805§grieve§griːv§I grieved very much for what I have done.§我为自己的行为感到非常**痛心**。§
21806§studio§ˈstjuːdiəʊ§On the other side of the reception area is the dance studio.§接待区的另一边是舞蹈**室**。§
21807§inhabitant§ɪnˈhæbɪtənt§The natural history of the Amazon is to a surprising extent tied to the activities of its prehistoric inhabitants.§亚马孙河的自然历史与其史前**居民**的活动有着极为密切的关系。§
21808§suicidal§ˌsuːɪˈsaɪdl§A telephone counseling service in this country gets more calls from people with suicidal feelings when it rains.§在这个国家，电话咨询服务在雨天会接到更多有**自杀**情绪的人打来的电话。§
21809§bilateral§ˌbaɪˈlætərəl§The two countries worked out a bilateral agreement.§两国达成了**双边**协议。§
21810§memorable§ˈmemərəbl§The trip to that village was memorable for us.§去那个村庄旅游是我们**难忘**的一次经历。§
21811§dazzle§ˈdæzl§Despite a lot of razzle-dazzle, the home basketball team has been beaten by 20 points.§主场篮球队尽管有许多令人**眼花缭乱**的假动作，但仍以20分之差落败。§改译文：dazzle 是「使眼花缭乱」，原译「迷惑人」改成「令人眼花缭乱」
21812§vast§vɑːst§Cutting down forests on a large scale has continued apace over vast areas.§**很多**地区仍在快速地大规模砍伐森林。§
21813§underground§ˌʌndəˈɡraʊnd§Water from the underground rivers bubbles to the surface as springs.§**地下**河的水以泉水的形式冒出地表。§

21814§scholar§ˈskɒlə(r)§The database is collected not merely for scholars, but for people involved in a whole range of educational and artistic purposes.§收集这些数据库不仅仅是为了给**学者**提供资料，也为所有从事教育和艺术工作的人们提供资料。§
21815§compete§kəmˈpiːt§A series of tests and interviews eventually left 280 applicants competing for the 120 advertised positions.§经过一系列的测试和面试之后，最终留下280名申请者来**竞争**招聘广告上的120个职位。§改译文：删去句末排版残留「手）」
21816§prescription§prɪˈskrɪpʃn§This medicine is not available without a prescription.§这种药只能凭**处方**购买。§
21817§crude§kruːd§The tribesmen still use bows, arrows and crude digging sticks.§该部落成员依然使用弓箭和**粗糙**的挖掘棍。§
21818§vary§ˈveəri§The price of a bed in different hotels always varies so much.§不同旅馆的床位价格总是**大不相同**。§
21819§compose§kəmˈpəʊz§All of the subjects which you undertake in the first year are composed of lectures and tutorials.§你第一年所要学习的所有科目都由讲座和辅导课**构成**。§
21820§alley§ˈæli§There are many blind alleys in this town.§这个镇子里有很多死**胡同**。§
21821§bounce§baʊns§Don't bounce on the bed, you'll break the springs!§别在床上乱**蹦**，你会把弹簧弄断的。§改例句：英文句中的中文感叹号改为英文感叹号
21822§platform§ˈplætfɔːm§This 520-hectare island serves as the platform for the new military airport.§这座520公顷的小岛是新军用机场的**起落台**。§
